Proposition
[harmonic-norm analogue]

Source: petersen:page-0432 ↗ def:pet-ch11-harmonic-norm ↗ prop:pet-ch11-norm-properties ↗ lem:pet-ch11-harmonic-coordinates-exist 1. ch11:11.3.5subsection 3.3 holds for the harmonic norm when $m\ge 1$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch11-harmonic-norm-properties \sketch Repeat subsection 3.3. The harmonic coordinates from subsection 2.3, normalized by $g_{ij}(p)=\delta _{ij}$, $\partial _kg_{ij}(p)=0$, give the small-scale limit. Under convergence, harmonic charts converge to harmonic charts, giving one semicontinuity inequality. For the reverse inequality, solve the harmonic Dirichlet problem on a slightly larger limiting chart; subsection 2.2 makes the solutions converge to the identity. Their inverses are admissible harmonic charts on the approximating manifolds. The remaining properties follow as before.

□
